def test_digits():
    # Single odd digit
    assert digits(1) == 1
    assert digits(3) == 3
    assert digits(9) == 9

    # Single even digit -> no odd digits, return 0
    assert digits(4) == 0
    assert digits(0) == 0

    # All even digits -> return 0
    assert digits(2468) == 0

    # Mixed digits -> product of odd digits only
    assert digits(235) == 15      # 3 * 5

    assert digits(13) == 3        # 1 * 3
    assert digits(13579) == 945   # 1 * 3 * 5 * 7 * 9

    # Repeated odd digits
    assert digits(555) == 125     # 5 * 5 * 5
    assert digits(7777) == 2401   # 7 * 7 * 7 * 7

    # Large number with even digits interspersed
    assert digits(123456789) == 945  # 1 * 3 * 5 * 7 * 9

    # Negative number (sign is ignored, '-' is not a digit)
    assert digits(-15) == 5       # odd digit 5
    assert digits(-246) == 0      # all even

    print("All tests passed!")
